event: "Ninety-first Annual Meeting of the Midwestern Psychological Association"
location: "Chicago, Illinois"
categories: ["Presentations", "Research", "Psychology"]
tags: ["open-minded-cognition", "social-norms", "information-processing", "group-dynamics", "conference-talk", "social-psychology"]
abstract: "The situational merit standard hypothesis states social norms dictate when open-minded condition (OMC) is appropriate. One context we expect normatively less open-mindedness are those involving group interactions."
---

In one study, we manipulated target group membership and measured OMC. In a second study, we manipulated open-minded norms within a group and measured OMC.

This research examines how social contexts and group dynamics influence our willingness to consider alternative perspectives and information.
